leo: quick PSA  onboarding sampleapp: intermittent SSE disconnect + duplicate final chunk when token refresh happens mid-stream. repro on web + android.
mira: can you paste a tiny repro/logs?
leo: steps: open sampleapp -> start stream -> force refresh at ~45s. sometimes UI shows two [DONE] frames. logs: [2026-04-10T14:02:15Z] sse: connected
[2026-04-10T14:03:00Z] auth: refresh start
[2026-04-10T14:03:00Z] sse: recv id=555 data="..."
[2026-04-10T14:03:00Z] sse: connection closed (1006)
[2026-04-10T14:03:00Z] client: reconnect last_event_id=555
[2026-04-10T14:03:00Z] sse: recv id=555 data="..." // duplicate
mira: sounds like parity: web aborts XHR on refresh, mobile waits. two fixes: 1) change sampleapps to avoid abort during refresh and rely on resume header, 2) add client dedupe by event id for 2s window (fallback to checksum).
jon: also standardize SSE parse semantics across sdks: emit only on full event delimiter (headers + blank line) to avoid partial-line ordering diffs.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4520: sse-resume-atomicity and queued staging job sse-onboard-fix.
leo: i'll open the web sampleapp PR to stop aborting and add a small README note for onboarding UX. mira: i'll add dedupe in js + python sdks and telemetry metric sse.resume.duplicate. jon: i'll coordinate mobile parity change.
mira: thanks. short-term UI mask for duplicate DONE frames in sampleapp too.
leo: resolving for now; will reopen if staging telemetry doesn't improve. :white_check_mark:
